nodes.title: After approving a voice sample • Create a reusable voice embedding
widgets_values: ONE-TIME SETUP: Copy the complete ComfyUI-VRHS folder into ComfyUI/custom_nodes, install requirements.txt with ComfyUI's Python, then restart. Preview is free and needs no fal key. Paid modes need FAL_KEY in ComfyUI's environment and a funded fal account. Select any of the 18 characters on the left. Empty script_override uses the chosen sample line. Ettin head A/B chooses one speaker. Change mode on the right: preview / audio / motion_video / talking_video / voice_embedding. duration_seconds applies only to silent motion. Talking video follows the speech audio. Outputs and receipts save to ComfyUI/output/VRHS/<character>. Repeat jobs reuse saved results. Increase generation_variant to request a new audition. Voice embedding mode requires an approved generated sample's HTTPS URL. For stable production, save its embedding URL in the selected character's voice record. See README.md for setup, voice approval and automation suggestions.
